prompt: With no security context at all, which user did the busybox process run as?

choices.why: `id` printed uid 0.
Right: uid 0, with fourteen capabilities.

choices.text: A random user picked by the kubelet
choices.why: The kubelet picks nothing unless told.
Your local user never reaches the node.
`/etc` was refused; `/tmp` would be too without a mount.

Ownership cannot beat a read-only mount.

prompt: `web` had `runAsNonRoot: true` and the image `nginx:1.29`. Why did it stop at `CreateContainerConfigError`?

choices.text: The image could not be pulled
choices.why: That would be `ErrImagePull`.
The pod was created; the kubelet refused to start the container.
Right, and nothing in the pod named another user.

choices.text: nginx needs port 80, which non-root cannot bind
choices.why: It never got that far; it was refused before starting.

prompt: Which Pod Security Standards level refuses a container that runs as root?

choices.why: It refuses nothing.
Baseline blocks known escalations, not root itself.
Right. It demands `runAsNonRoot`.
Restricted refused `plain` for exactly that.

prompt: You label a busy namespace `enforce=restricted`. What happens to the pods already running in it?
hint: The dry run printed warnings and labelled nothing.

choices.text: They keep running; new pods are checked
choices.why: Right. The level applies to new pods, and the label prints warnings about existing ones.

choices.text: Non-compliant ones are evicted at once
choices.why: Nothing is evicted by a label.

choices.text: The label is refused until they comply
choices.why: The label is accepted, with a warning.

choices.text: They are restarted with the new rules applied
choices.why: A label restarts nothing.

prompt: Why was `kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx` refused by `no-latest-tag`?
hint: What tag does a bare name get?

choices.text: nginx is not allowed at all
choices.why: `nginx:1.29` was accepted a moment later.

choices.text: It has no colon, so no tag
choices.why: Right. A bare name means `latest`, and the expression demands a colon.
The message named the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy.

choices.text: The binding only allows the default namespace
choices.why: The binding had no namespace restriction.

prompt: Which image would `no-latest-tag`'s expression let through although it has no tag?
hint: Where else can a colon appear in an image name?

choices.why: No colon, so it is refused.
It ends in `:latest`, so it is refused.
Right. The colon belongs to the port.
That has a tag, and is meant to pass.
